speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the severity and location of your itching, and have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: The itching is severe and covers my entire body, leaving scratch marks on my trunk and limbs. I have also noticed that my eyes look yellow and my urine has become very dark. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of jaundice, dark urine, and severe generalized pruritus strongly suggests cholestasis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis
